CHIEF COMPLAINT
Ongoing management of psoriatic arthritis.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Judy Gomez is a patient with psoriatic arthritis presenting today for routine follow-up. She has been tapering prednisone as previously planned and is currently taking 1 mg daily, which she reports is adequate for symptom control. She has occasionally required an additional dose approximately once weekly due to increased foot pain, particularly on days when she is more active away from her desk job. Methotrexate has been beneficial for joint pain control. Patient held methotrexate for one week prior to her first COVID-19 vaccine due to concerns about vaccine efficacy based on information received, which resulted in significant pain exacerbation. She restarted methotrexate one week later and continued it with her second vaccine dose per phone hotline recommendation. Patient reports easy bruising on her extremities when bumped, with bruises appearing without her feeling the initial injury. She notes she does not know where they are coming from.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for joint pain in feet and other joints, easy bruising. Knee pain had been present but is significantly improved with methotrexate dose adjustment. Ridging of nails present from psoriasis, chronic and long-standing. Otherwise negative.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Psoriatic arthritis.

MEDICATIONS
Prednisone 1 mg daily (to be discontinued), methotrexate.

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Works a desk job. More mobile on days off from work, which increases joint pain.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Patient seated with shoes and socks removed. Hand and finger joints: minimal tenderness to palpation. Foot joints: mild discomfort noted. Knee flexion: good range of motion without significant pain. Toe flexion: good range of motion. Nails: ridging present consistent with psoriasis.

RESULTS
Blood work appointment to be scheduled.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Psoriatic arthritis: Responding well to current methotrexate therapy. Discontinue prednisone 1 mg daily today. Continue methotrexate with close monitoring as it is a high-risk medication. Easy bruising likely secondary to prednisone use; expect improvement with discontinuation. Schedule blood work appointment at front desk. Follow-up visit in 3 months.
